input.rationale: This APCN 2 Construction & Maintenance Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant of any kind. Independent full-text searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "personnel", "staff", "recruit" and "induce ... to leave" (including a combined regex sweep) returned no hits, and the section outline shows no restrictive-covenant article; the operative covenants introduced at p0043 run to configuration, cost allocation, capacity, maintenance, default, confidentiality and dispute resolution only (the sole restraints, e.g. the assignment and confidentiality provisions, do not touch personnel). Accordingly we sit at the preferred position: no non-solicitation restriction binds Teleglobe USA Inc. Nothing to redline; we would resist any attempt to introduce such a covenant, and would accept at most a mutual 12-month restriction limited to personnel directly involved, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
